definitions.explanation: The act of confining someone in prison, typically as punishment for a crime. A formal term used in legal and news contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{投獄|とうごく}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
{政治犯|せいじはん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{不当|ふとう}→不当：11319_futou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{投獄|とうごく}⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Political prisoners are being unjustly imprisoned.

examples.japanese: {活動家|かつどうか}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{投獄|とうごく}⟦されて→する：00392_suru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{信念|しんねん}→信念：03074_shinnen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{曲|ま}げなかった→曲げる：02529_mageru⟧。
examples.english: The activist did not waver in their convictions even when imprisoned.

notes:
{投獄|とうごく} combines {投|とう} (throw) + {獄|ごく} (prison), literally "to throw into prison." A formal term used in news, legal writing, and historical contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {投獄|とうごく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to imprison
- {投獄|とうごく}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: to be imprisoned (passive, very common)
- ⟦{不当|ふとう}→不当：11319_futou⟧な{投獄|とうごく}: unjust imprisonment
- {投獄|とうごく}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧{恐|おそ}れ: risk of imprisonment

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {収監|しゅうかん}: confinement in prison (also formal)
- {拘禁|こうきん}: detention, confinement
- {禁固|きんこ}/⟦{禁錮|きんこ}→禁錮：19211_kinko⟧: imprisonment (as a legal sentence)
- ⟦{懲役|ちょうえき}→懲役：11087_choueki⟧: imprisonment with hard labor

REGISTER:
This is a written/formal word. In casual speech, ⟦{牢屋|ろうや}→牢屋：15832_rouya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れられる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧ or ⟦{刑務所|けいむしょ}→刑務所：19074_keimusho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧ are more natural.
